title: Scam
body:
This program exists solely to collect money from users. After seeing an ad on Instagram, I decided to give it a try because I struggle with bad habits and routines. However, within seconds of opening the app, it immediately tries to get you to pay. You can’t even add new tasks, as the app blocks this feature unless you subscribe or pay for a service period.

I recommend looking for another app that actually lets you try its features before asking for money.

title: Good luck
body:
I downloaded this app after seeing an Instagram ad, thinking it might be useful for simple, everyday reminders.

Instead of activating a free trial, I was immediately charged for a discounted yearly subscription. Thanks — I didn’t know where to spend my extra money 🙃
I decided to give it a chance anyway, maybe it was a sign I’d actually use it.

In reality, it turned out to be a very basic to-do list. There are better and cheaper alternatives out there. But the most annoying part is what happens after completing every single task: an unskippable animated screen pops up, telling you how great you are, showing points and other gamified nonsense I have zero interest in.

You cannot skip these animations and you cannot turn them off in settings. Every time you complete a task, you’re forced to wait until the animation ends before you can continue using the app. It feels like using the free version of Duolingo — but worse.

Deleted the app and cancelled the subscription.

title: Beware of Misleading Trial Offer!
body: I am extremely disappointed with my experience using this app. I signed up for the free trial as advertised, expecting to test the features before any charges would be made.
